centreline_definitions_mm.method: Derived from the midpoints of visually associated A11/as-1 outer-member traces in the calibrated Section_A11_Axis_1 projection. The drawing traces determine member axis length; text location is not used as geometry.
centreline_definitions_mm.section_orientation: A11/as-1 is a YZ elevation at X=65160 mm. The HEA200 column and HEA180 rafter section height h is in the elevation plane. The five IPE300 column source contour pairs show flange width b=150 mm in the elevation plane, so section height h=300 mm is placed out of plane along X.
